arguments.command:
cd /home/runner/work/pi-action/pi-action; git add -A src/storage && git commit -q -m "feat(storage): snapshot and restore the working tree as git stash commits

src/storage/worktree.ts captures the index, the tracked files on disk, and
the untracked files that are not ignored as git's own stash commits (I, U,
W), built in temporary index files so the real index and files are never
touched. Snapshots are chained on refs/pi/worktrees/<n> as wrapper commits
with parents [previous wrapper, W] and Thread-Tip, Thread-Entry, Branch,
Head and Skipped trailers.

Restoring puts HEAD on the recorded branch (recreating a local-only one,
following a remote branch that moved ahead, refusing one that diverged),
applies the stash with --index, falls back to the working tree only, keeps
conflict markers, and starts clean on failure. uniqueWork() finds the files
and local commits a newer snapshot has that an older one would drop.

Refs #33" && git push -q 2>&1 | tail -1; git log --oneline -1
